fields.value: Additional file 2 of FunMappOne: a tool to hierarchically organize and visually navigate functional gene annotations in multiple experiments

dsDescriptionValue.value: Excel file containing input data for the case study. The excel file is composed of one sheet for each exposure and a last sheet containing grouping information. Each exposure sheet is named with the exposure ID and contains two columns containing the list of selected genes and the associated t-statistics, respectively. The last sheet contains two columns: one reporting the list of exposure IDs and another the corresponding group. (XLSX 63 kb)

publicationCitation.value: FunMappOne : a tool to hierarchically organize and visually navigate functional gene annotations in multiple experiments
